messages:
sam_devex: heads-up — release pipeline blocked on js-sdk publish, CI failing because typegen checksum mismatch. cannot push release branch.
build-bot: publish job failed (npm): exit code 1 — see logs in GHA.
sam_devex: relevant log snippet:
```
Typegen checksum mismatch for @redwood/sdk-js
expected: 0a1b2c3d4e5f
actual:   cafebabedead
Action: regen type definitions and commit
```
maria_infra: hmm, did someone run the regen step before the last commit? the CI had regen step but it was cached.
lee_codegen: I think the generator changed formatting in the new openapi spec PR — whitespace normalization and enum ordering. should be a small diff but checksum is different.
ashley_sdk: this explains the failing parity tests — sample-app integration shows an auth/retry header shape change after the regen. we need to confirm if that was intended.
oliver_qe: failing test: sample-app/login.spec.js -> expects retry header 'x-rw-retry' not present. stack trace points to generated client sending undefined when retry.enabled=false.
lee_codegen: quick idea: run `yarn typegen:regen` locally, commit the updated types then rerun CI. but we need to ensure semver and changelog implications.
sam_devex: question: does this change API surface (breaking/change in optional param ordering) or purely cosmetic? if API changed we need a minor at least and a changelog entry.
ashley_sdk: looks like one param switched from optional to required in the generated signature (surprising). I suspect a mapping bug in the generator for x-required flags.
maria_infra: for an emergency unblock, can we pin the previous typegen artifact in the publish job? cheap workaround: skip publish of js-sdk and publish other packages. but release tooling expects atomic release.
lee_codegen: not ideal. I'll open a quick PR to revert the generator tweak that reordered parameters and add a test to catch header parity.
ashley_sdk: I'll add a temporary integration test to sample-app CI to catch header absence. catching early will prevent future publish blocks.
oliver_qe: for the changelog: draft a short note "fix: typegen param ordering causing auth header mismatch" — should that be a patch or minor? leaning patch if this was a bug introduced in same minor.
sam_devex: decision: if generator produced an unintended param change -> patch release after regen revert. if intended new behavior -> minor with migration note and update sample apps.
lee_codegen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/openapi/commit/regen-revert-1934 (WIP) — includes `yarn typegen:regen` output and test.
maria_infra: CI note: caching caused an older generator binary to run against a newer openapi spec, producing mismatch. will add cache keys tied to openapi spec sha.
ashley_sdk: thanks — once lee's PR lands, I'll run local regen and run `yarn test:integration` before merging.
sam_devex: tagging release captain: @maria_infra please coordinate publishing after PR merge and confirm changelog entry.
maria_infra: will do. also adding a temporary CI gate: require `yarn typegen:check` step to pass before publish job. :white_check_mark: 
lee_codegen: sorry for the churn — adding a changelog fragment in the PR and a short note in the SDK release checklist to run regen locally.
build-bot: deploy pipeline resumed, waiting on PR merge.
ashley_sdk: follow-up: I reproduced locally. patch ready. once merged I'll bump patch version and prepare the release notes.
sam_devex: great — thanks everyone. long-term action items: (1) add typegen checksum check to pre-commit, (2) lock generator binary in CI with spec sha, (3) add parity test to sample-apps so auth/retry regressions fail fast.
lee_codegen: adding items to infra backlog.
ashley_sdk: I'll draft a tiny onboarding doc for new contributors: "how to run regen and run parity checks" to reduce friction.
sam_devex: closing loop — please add the changelog fragment to the release PR and ping here when CI green. :thumbsup:
